name: WiFiScan
description: WiFi/examples/WiFiScan, unmodified: the sketch sets the station mode and scans every channel (WiFi.scanNetworks, ESP-IDF's esp_wifi_scan_start below it); the two access points nearby answer its probe requests, and it prints each one with its SSID, its RSSI at the board (free-space loss at 2.4 GHz over their distance), its channel and its security, as on a real board.
